summary: In `Command.format_arguments`, the section guard changed from "any argument produced a help record" to "any argument has a non-None `help`", and when that holds the section now writes a row for every `Argument` returned by `get_params`, not just the documented ones. `Argument.get_help_record` is re-typed and re-implemented to always return a `(metavar, help)` tuple, substituting an empty description when `help` is unset, and the change is recorded in CHANGES.md and the docs.
